corrections.corrected_text: [፵] ሉቃ ፲ ፲፮ ዮሐ ፲፫ ፳ እናንተ↵
corrections.reason: The printed numeral is ፲ (Luke 10:16: ሉቃ ፲ ፲፮), not ፳.
Both the printed 6th-order glyph እ and the canonical Ge'ez citation (ዝራዕ እክለከ ውስተ መቃብረ ጻድቃን, 'sow thy bread/grain upon the graves of the righteous') require እክለከ.
The word wraps across L38-L39 as ሕፅ↵በት ('washing the feet of the righteous').
